name: io.github.rixile9999/tdl-mcp
description: Read-only Telegram MCP server wrapping the tdl CLI: list chats, read messages, download media.

environmentVariables.name: TDL_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the tdl binary (default: tdl on PATH, falling back to /opt/homebrew/bin/tdl)

environmentVariables.name: TDL_NS
environmentVariables.description: tdl namespace passed as -n on every call, for separate Telegram accounts/sessions
